caption: A tray of dry rice is tilted to one side, and the rice slides to the low edge and piles up there while the high side clears.

sa.check: A tray of dry rice is tilted to one side.
The rice slides to the low edge.
The tilt comes first and the slide follows.

pc.expect: The grains flow downhill as a sheet and collect against the low rim.
pc.fail: They move uphill; or stay spread evenly on the tilted tray; or float.

pc.expect: The flow starts once the tilt is steep enough and not before.
pc.fail: It slides on a level tray; or slides before the tilt; or keeps flowing with the tray level again.

pc.expect: The grains flow and pile at a slope.
pc.fail: They flow flat like liquid; or move as a solid block; or bounce like balls.

pc.expect: The pile only grows on the low side while tilted.
pc.fail: It shrinks; or redistributes; or appears before the tilt.

pc.expect: One tray keeps its number and the rice its total.
pc.fail: Rice appears from nowhere; or vanishes; or the tray duplicates.

pc.expect: The tray and the rice stay the same.
pc.fail: The tray changes colour; or the rice changes colour; or the background rearranges.
